name: Toujou Youhei
source:
The main character of this work. His trademark is his affable smile and words that can be seen as somewhat timid. He knows it himself, but he also feels that there is no way to cure it.

Since childhood, he has been friends with his step sister and childhood friends... Perhaps it is because he grew up surrounded by girls that he is not good at boyish behavior!

Whether the day will ever come when he can overcome this is also a mystery. (According to his sister).
